elements.label: Figure O.17: Rates of chronic insecurity and risk-induced insecurity by region, 2020
elements.description: Stacked bar chart with a secondary-axis dot overlay. Left y-axis: 'Percent' (0 to 70). Right y-axis: 'Ratio of Chronic/Risk' (0 to 4.5). Categories: All; Red River Delta; Midlands & Northern Mountains; North & Central Coast; Central Highlands; Southeast; Mekong. Legend: Chronic Economic Insecurity (teal bar segment); Risk-induced Economic Insecurity (orange bar segment, stacked on top); Chronic: Risk Ratio (purple dot, right axis). No values are printed on the chart; approximate readings: All: chronic ~22%, risk-induced ~11% (total ~33%), ratio ~1.9. Red River Delta: chronic ~5%, risk-induced ~9% (total ~14%), ratio ~0.6. Midlands & Northern Mountains: chronic ~51%, risk-induced ~13% (total ~64%), ratio ~3.9. North & Central Coast: chronic ~25%, risk-induced ~12% (total ~37%), ratio ~2.2. Central Highlands: chronic ~32%, risk-induced ~15% (total ~47%), ratio ~2.1. Southeast: chronic ~10%, risk-induced ~7% (total ~17%), ratio ~1.3. Mekong: chronic ~13%, risk-induced ~13% (total ~26%), ratio ~1.0. Pattern: the Midlands & Northern Mountains has the highest chronic insecurity and chronic-to-risk ratio, while the Red River Delta has the lowest ratio, with chronic insecurity well below risk-induced insecurity.

elements.label: Figure O.18: Relative importance of idiosyncratic and covariate risk by region, 2020
elements.description: Scatter-style chart with a horizontal reference line. Y-axis: 'Ratio of Idiosyncratic/Covariate Risk' (0 to 1.8, ticks at 0.2 intervals). Categories on x-axis: All; Red River Delta; Midlands & Northern Mountains; North & Central Coast; Central Highlands; Southeast; Mekong. Legend: Chronic Economic Insecurity (teal horizontal line at 1); Chronic: Risk Ratio (orange dot). No values are printed; approximate readings for the orange dots: All ~1.25, Red River Delta ~1.7, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~1.12, North & Central Coast ~1.18, Central Highlands ~1.28, Southeast ~1.28, Mekong ~1.49. The teal line is constant at ~1. Pattern: every region's ratio is at or above 1, with the Red River Delta highest and the Midlands & Northern Mountains lowest.
